courses.title: Viral Hook Formula
courses.description:
Learn how to create clear, compelling openings for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Viral Hook Formula introduces eight practical approaches: curiosity gaps, pattern interrupts, bold statements, questions, stories, visuals, numbered lists and relatable POV scenes.

Across ten lessons, you will learn to write stronger first lines, plan effective opening visuals and connect every hook to a meaningful payoff. Practical examples and assignments help you choose the right approach for your audience, communicate your topic quickly and deliver the value your opening promises. You will also explore how to combine hook styles, use ChatGPT to develop relevant options and compare different openings to improve your content.

Designed for creators, small business owners and students, the course concludes with a practical project: creating eight original reels, one for each hook type, using a repeatable process for planning, reviewing and refining your ideas.

courses.title: AI Cartoon Series
courses.description:
Learn how to create an original children’s cartoon series using ChatGPT, Google Flow and CapCut. This practical course takes you from your first idea to a complete animated episode, using Golu and Chiku as a running example.

You will develop distinctive characters, create reusable reference sheets and locations, write engaging stories for young audiences, and organise them into simple scenes. Step-by-step lessons explain how to generate start frames, animate short clips, plan character voices and maintain continuity across an episode. You will also produce an original rhyme video and learn practical ways to correct common visual and audio issues.

The course concludes with editing, thumbnail design, publishing preparation and a plan for future episodes. Designed for parents, teachers and aspiring creators, it requires no prior drawing or animation experience and focuses on building a clear, repeatable production workflow.

courses.title: AI Local Business Ads
courses.description:
AI Local Business Ads
Professional course description
AI Local Business Ads is a practical, beginner-friendly course designed to help small business owners and
aspiring local content creators produce honest, effective marketing assets using accessible AI tools. Through
ten focused lessons, learners move from understanding a business and its customers to creating polished
shop and menu photography, offer and festival posters, short promotional videos, Hindi voiceover reels and
manageable publishing plans.
The course demonstrates how ChatGPT supports business briefs, writing and planning; how Google Flow can
assist with image and video creation; how CapCut brings clips together; and how ElevenLabs can provide an
optional text-to-speech workflow. It also introduces the fundamentals of offering this work as a service to
neighborhood businesses.
What learners will gain
Build a reusable business brief with customer segments, advertising angles and a content calendar.
Improve real shop, food and product photos while preserving their authentic appearance.
Create promotional posters using exact, approved wording and verified prices.
Produce short vertical reels and natural Hindi voiceovers.
Prepare platform-specific content for Instagram, WhatsApp and Google Business Profile.
Package creative services, collect client requirements and manage approvals.
Who this course is for
Owners of cafes, salons, bakeries, neighborhood stores and other local businesses.
Beginners interested in creating AI-assisted marketing content for nearby shops.
Content creators seeking a practical, ethical workflow for small-business clients.

courses.title: AI Product Photoshoot & Ads
courses.description:
**AI Product Photoshoot & Ads**

Learn how to transform ordinary product photos into professional AI-generated visuals and engaging advertisements. This practical course covers studio photography, AI model shoots, festive product images, colour variations, cinematic product videos, and UGC-style ads.

Using **Google Flow, Nano Banana Pro, and ChatGPT**, you'll learn to create compelling marketing content, develop ad scripts, and build a complete product advertisement without expensive photography equipment.

Perfect for beginners, content creators, freelancers, and e-commerce business owners looking to enhance their product marketing with AI.

courses.title: AI Filmmaking Course
courses.description:
AI Filmmaking: From Imagination to Screen
Go beyond generating videos. Learn to tell stories that connect.
Turn your creative ideas into cinematic visuals with Skillomate’s AI Filmmaking course. Designed for beginners, this practical course introduces you to storytelling and AI-powered filmmaking—without requiring previous filmmaking experience, a physical camera, or live actors. 
Across eight focused lessons, learn to shape an idea into a compelling story, build character-reference sheets, and turn your creative direction into shot-by-shot prompts. Use ChatGPT to develop your narrative and plan your visuals, then bring those plans to life in Google Flow. Practise generating takes, selecting stronger results, and connecting shots while maintaining character and scene continuity
Discover how to give every shot a purpose. Explore eight camera-movement approaches and six framing techniques, learning how to use them to build tension, reveal a setting, highlight emotion, or draw viewers into a character’s perspective. The focus is not simply on how a shot looks, but on what it communicates. 
Follow a clear filmmaking framework—Story → Characters → Shots → Sound → Editing—and understand where voiceover and editing fit into the process, with introductions to ElevenLabs and CapCut. Practical exercises and ready-to-use prompts support your learning as you build a foundation in story development, character creation, and cinematic shot generation.

courses.title: AI Influencer Course
courses.description:
## AI Influencer Mastery

Learn how to **create, grow, and monetize your own AI influencer** from scratch with a practical, step-by-step system.

Across **34 focused lessons**, you’ll learn how to build a consistent AI character, generate realistic photos and videos, create talking and lip-sync content, edit professional Reels, and develop a strong social media presence.

You’ll also explore real-world applications including **AI product photography, fashion try-ons, UGC videos, brand collaborations, client outreach, pricing, portfolio building, affiliate marketing, and digital products**.

Designed for beginners, creators, freelancers, and business owners, the course focuses on practical execution without requiring coding, professional cameras, or advanced editing skills.

**By the end, you’ll have a complete AI creator system—from your first character to content, clients, and monetization opportunities.**
